heading: Compilation and publication of data

tree.text: The Authority shall maintain a file of its proceedings and copies of all available agreements and arbitration decisions, and shall publish the texts of its decisions and the actions taken by the Panel under section 7119 of this title.
All files maintained under subsection (a) of this section shall be open to inspection and reproduction in accordance with the provisions of sections 552 and 552a of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective 90 days after Oct. 13, 1978, see section 907 of Pub. L. 95–454, set out as an Effective Date of 1978 Amendment note under section 1101 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 95–454, title VII, § 701, Oct. 13, 1978, 92 Stat. 1215.)
